conjectures.title: Quadratic logarithmic growth of cumulative two-primary stable stems
conjectures.statement: If f(k) is the product of the orders of the two-primary stable homotopy groups in stems 1 through k, then log_2(f(k))/k^2 tends to a nonzero constant.

conjectures.title: Eventual nonvanishing of the two-primary component of pi_m(S^3)
conjectures.statement: The two-primary component of pi_m(S^3) is nontrivial for every m greater than 10.

conjectures.title: New Doomsday Conjecture for Sq^0-families
conjectures.statement: For every Adams filtration s there is an n(s) such that no nonzero class in the image of (Sq^0)^(n(s)) in the mod-two Adams E_2-page at filtration s is a permanent cycle.

source.progress_note: Li--Li prove the e-family case only.

conjectures.title: Freyd generating hypothesis
conjectures.statement: A map between finite spectra that induces zero on every stable homotopy group is nullhomotopic; equivalently, stable homotopy groups are faithful on finite spectra.

conjectures.title: Curtis spherical-classes conjecture at two
conjectures.statement: In positive degrees, the spherical classes in H_*(Q_0 S^0; F_2), equivalently the image of the stable mod-two Hurewicz map, are exactly those arising from Hopf-invariant-one and Kervaire-invariant-one elements.

conjectures.title: Moore exponent conjecture
conjectures.statement: For a finite simply connected CW complex X and prime p, the p-primary torsion in all homotopy groups of X has a uniform finite exponent if and only if the direct sum of its rational homotopy groups is finite-dimensional.

conjectures.title: Unique smooth structures on high-dimensional spheres
conjectures.statement: In dimensions greater than four, the only spheres with unique smooth structure are S^5, S^6, S^12, S^56, and S^61.

conjectures.title: Eccles spherical-class conjecture for QX
conjectures.statement: For a pointed path-connected space X, a positive-dimensional spherical class in H_*(QX; F_2) is either stably spherical or arises from a stable map detected by a primary operation in its mapping cone.

conjectures.title: Lannes--Zarati positive-stem vanishing above filtration two
conjectures.statement: The s-th Lannes--Zarati homomorphism vanishes in every positive stem for s greater than 2.

conjectures.title: Ravenel EHP differential pattern for eta_j
conjectures.statement: For j>=3 and k=(2s+1)2^(j-2) with s>0, the predicted EHP differential d_(2^(j-2))(nu)=eta_j occurs.

conjectures.title: Conditional Kervaire EHP differential pattern
conjectures.statement: For j>=2 and s>0, whenever theta_j exists as in Ravenel Conjecture 1.5.27(i), the EHP class bar_alpha_j in E_2^{2^(j+1)(2s+1)-2,*} satisfies d_r(bar_alpha_j)=theta_j, where r=2^(j+1)-1-dim(bar_alpha_j).

conjectures.title: Chromatic Mahowald/root-invariant height raising
conjectures.statement: Whenever the Greek-letter elements alpha_j^(n) and alpha_j^(n+1) both exist in homotopy, alpha_j^(n+1) lies in the Mahowald invariant M(alpha_j^(n)).

conjectures.title: Mahowald invariant of consecutive Kervaire classes
conjectures.statement: Whenever both consecutive Kervaire classes theta_j and theta_(j+1) exist, theta_(j+1) lies in the Mahowald invariant M(theta_j).

conjectures.title: Ravenel beta_1 exponent pattern at primes at least seven
conjectures.statement: For p>=7, beta_1^(p^2-p) is nonzero, beta_1^(p^2-p+1) vanishes, and the higher Toda bracket <gamma_3,gamma_2,...,gamma_2>, with gamma_2 repeated (p-5)/2 times, equals beta_1^((2p-1)(p-1)/2).

conjectures.title: Weak chromatic splitting conjecture
conjectures.statement: For every prime p, height n>=1, and finite spectrum X, L_(n-1) of the p-completion of X is a wedge summand of L_(n-1)L_K(n) of the p-completion of X.

source.locator: Hovey, Introduction p. 2 (weak finite-spectrum form); Conjecture 4.2(v) (sphere splitting)
source.status_note: Beaudry disproves the stronger explicit decomposition at n=p=2 without contradicting this wedge-summand assertion.

missing: split monomorphisms in a stable category

conjectures.title: Very exotic spheres outside the exceptional dimensions
conjectures.statement: Very exotic spheres exist in every dimension greater than four except 5, 6, 11, 12, 27, 43, 56, and 61.

provisional_results.title: Kervaire invariant one in dimension 126
provisional_results.statement: A smooth framed manifold of Kervaire invariant one exists in dimension 126, completing the dimensions 2, 6, 14, 30, 62, and 126.
provisional_results.note: Do not list this as an open conjecture; retain the preprint qualifier until publication status is updated.

no_longer_open.title: Ravenel telescope conjecture
no_longer_open.note: The cited preprint claims counterexamples at every prime and every height at least two; retain the preprint qualifier pending published verification.

no_longer_open.title: Strong classical chromatic-splitting decomposition
no_longer_open.note: Keep the weaker split-monic formulation in the conjecture registry, not this stronger decomposition.

no_longer_open.title: Kervaire invariant one beyond dimension 126
no_longer_open.note: Hill--Hopkins--Ravenel rule out theta_j for j>=7; theta_6 is separately tracked as a provisional positive result.

no_longer_open.title: Singer algebraic transfer injectivity in every rank and degree
no_longer_open.note: Recent preprints claim rank-five and rank-six counterexamples, so the unqualified global statement is not listed as a credible open conjecture.

needs_reformulation.title: Ravenel odd-primary EHP birth pattern
needs_reformulation.note: Conjecture 1.5.20 has an explicit p=3 exception and needs a corrected precise formulation before entering the conjecture registry.

needs_reformulation.title: Odd-primary spherical-class restrictions
needs_reformulation.note: The handoff records a family of analogies rather than one precise universally accepted conjecture.

needs_reformulation.title: Smith--Toda complex existence pattern
needs_reformulation.note: Existence and nonexistence depend on prime and height; the raw row is not one quantified conjecture.

research_programs.title: Chromatic redshift for algebraic K-theory
research_programs.note: The handoff combines lower-bound and descent expectations using non-falsifiable qualifiers; retain it as a research program until a precise Ausoni--Rognes formulation is sourced.

research_programs.title: Hopkins--Mahowald height-two family predictions
research_programs.note: Recent work confirms many predicted families, but the chart is neither a single proposition nor known exhaustive.

research_programs.title: Sharp unstable homotopy growth laws
research_programs.note: The handoff calls for sharper explicit chromatic laws but does not supply one falsifiable asymptotic statement.

conditional_scenarios.title: Asymptotic stable-stem growth sharpness scenario
conditional_scenarios.note: The proposed sharp scale is conditional on a strong form of telescope failure.

heuristics.title: Mahowald uncertainty principle
heuristics.note: Useful context, but intentionally excluded from the credible conjecture list.

out_of_scope.title: Smooth four-dimensional Poincare conjecture
out_of_scope.note: Precise and credible, but separate from stable-stem methods and the high-dimensional surgery bridge used by this benchmark.
